title: Monty Hall Simulator
description: Simulate the Monty Hall problem: compare win rates of staying vs switching over thousands of trials.
howto: Choose the number of trials and doors.
Compare the stay vs switch win percentages and bars.

faqs.a: Your first pick is right only 1/3 of the time. When it’s wrong (2/3), the host’s reveal leaves the prize behind the other door — so switching wins 2/3.

faqs.q: Does more doors change the answer?
faqs.a: Staying always wins 1/D. Switching to a random other unopened door wins (D−1)/(D(D−2)) — still better than staying.
Yes — prize door, initial pick, host’s reveal and the switch target are all drawn uniformly at random each trial.
